triggers.mission_stats_on_event: CREATE TRIGGER mission_stats_on_event AFTER INSERT ON events BEGIN UPDATE mission_stats SET event_count = event_count + 1, last_event_at = CASE WHEN last_event_at IS NULL OR new.timestamp > last_event_at THEN new.timestamp ELSE last_event_at END, last_result_id = CASE WHEN new.type = 'result' AND NOT (CASE WHEN json_valid(new.payload) THEN json_type(new.payload, '$.timon_steered') IS 'true' ELSE 0 END) THEN new.id ELSE last_result_id END, last_user_id = CASE WHEN new.type = 'user' THEN new.id ELSE last_user_id END, last_result_model = CASE WHEN new.type = 'result' THEN CASE WHEN json_valid(new.payload) AND json_type(new.payload) = 'object' THEN CASE WHEN json_type(new.payload, '$.model') IS NOT NULL AND json_type(new.payload, '$.model') <> 'null' THEN CASE WHEN json_type(new.payload, '$.model') = 'text' THEN NULLIF(json_extract(new.payload, '$.model'), '') END WHEN json_type(new.payload, '$.modelID') = 'text' THEN NULLIF(json_extract(new.payload, '$.modelID'), '') END END ELSE last_result_model END WHERE mission_id = new.mission_id; END
